lines.2: Seeing Yashi today reminded me of something.
lines.3: The others still didn't know about Subaru transferring or Kinu and me dating.
lines.4: We could tell the executive council everything once the new term began.
lines.5: 「Hmm. Your hair's getting a little long, Leo.」
lines.8: Kinu was good with her hands, so I had her cut my hair.
lines.9: For all that dexterity, her cooking was terrible because she dumped in seasonings without thinking.
lines.10: 「Hey, don't give me some weird haircut.」
lines.11: 「I won't. From now on, you're my Leo too.」
lines.12: 「And my boyfriend might as well look good.」
lines.14: I was weak against such open affection.
lines.15: It made Kinu look even cuter.
lines.16: On the way back from the hospital...
lines.17: 「Good news. You're healing up just fine.」
lines.18: 「Yeah. Thanks to all that attentive nursing.」
lines.23: There she went saying something embarrassing again.
lines.24: And casually taking my hand while she was at it.
lines.25: I loved Kinu. I loved her so much.
lines.26: But I still belonged to myself.
lines.27: 「...I'm not becoming half of some obnoxious lovey-dovey couple, Kinu.」
lines.28: 「Though when we're alone, I want to lay it on pretty thick.」
lines.29: 「It's not like I'm trying to become some obnoxious couple either.」
lines.30: She swung our joined hands back and forth.
lines.33: Damn, that was a sweet thing for her to say...
lines.36: Outside, the cicada symphony was in full chorus.
lines.37: Actually, something had been bothering me lately.
